'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Greetings, warrior. How's life on the front lines? I've heard plenty about your skill with firearms, and I've tested you myself more than once. But when it comes to grenades, that's a different story. You need intuition, and you need brains, unless you want to catch your own shrapnel by accident. So show me what you can do with grenades and underbarrel launchers. Go make some noise in Tarkov.}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate any 5 targets with [[Weapons#Fragmentation grenades|hand grenades]] or [[Weapon mods#Gear Mods|grenade launchers]]

==Rewards==
* +10,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Prapor]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.25'''</font>
* 165,000 Roubles
** 173,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 189,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
{{quote|Good, limbs are still attached, and you certainly stirred things up. Looks like you'll be useful in this kind of work, soldier. Here's your reward, you've earned it.}}

==Guide==
In this quest you have to kill any 5 targets with [[Weapons#Fragmentation grenades|grenades]] or [[Weapon mods#Gear Mods|underbarrel grenade launchers]]. 

[[Weapons#Grenade launchers|Standalone grenade launchers]] and [[Weapons#Rocket launchers|rocket launchers]] can '''not''' be used.
